# Remote Control Agent v0.1.40 — GitHub-hosted Session-only enrollment

- Adds an opt-in, noninteractive **Session-only** Agent entrypoint for the existing `ubuntu` and `windows` GitHub Actions Sessions (Spec [#62](https://github.com/lirtual/github-actions/issues/62)). A reviewed physical GitHub OIDC proof and a fresh Ed25519 identity bind each Agent to one exact Session Attempt.
- Session identity and operation receipts are stored privately inside the disposable GitHub Runner job. Windows enforces native directory/file ACL checks; Linux enforces owner-only permissions. An ordinary permanent or manually approved temporary Agent is not converted into a Session Agent.
- The existing Agent Release candidates include the packaged Session entrypoints. The feature remains disabled in `github-actions` until a matching reviewed Release SHA-256 is configured, the Workflow authorization Worker and D1 migration have been deployed, and a reviewed immutable Session Workflow Plan is published.
- Release packaging was exercised by the native Linux x64/ARM64 and Windows x64 CI plus offline extraction and no-execution bootstrap tests. **No real production Session enrollment, WSS/files/Shell operation or Stop/expiry E2E has yet been demonstrated by this code review.** Those are separate post-rollout acceptance gates.

Source: [Agent PR #78](https://github.com/lirtual/remote-control-agent/pull/78), [Actions PR #74](https://github.com/lirtual/github-actions/pull/74), [Worker PR #519](https://github.com/lirtual/mcp-workers/pull/519). The Release publish action must not be merged or dispatched without explicit production authorization.
